invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.6.0 includes customer-level receipts, invoice overpayments and unapplied customer credit, later allocation and immutable unallocation, reconciliation with reasoned unreconciliation, refunds and refund reversals, idempotent receipt posting, granular payment automation events, allocation-aware accounting, paid-invoice reopening, rolling-deployment-safe legacy direct-AR compatibility, and normalized/null-safe monthly dashboard date rendering. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
